reader.reads: Plato, Sophist 235d–236b, in the Greek public corpus, beside the registers’ readings.

thesis.ru: Чужеземец различает воспроизведение размеров и цветов образца и работу, в которой художники больших произведений меняют действительные пропорции ради кажущейся красоты с точки зрения зрителя.
thesis.en: The Stranger distinguishes reproducing the proportions and colours of a model from the work of artists who adjust the actual proportions of large works so they look beautiful to the viewer.

conceptions.note: Both registers describe the distinction through 236c. This reading is confined to 235d–236b: the later definition of phantasm is not included. The Russian corpus splits a sentence across units 235–236 and translates the later 236b viewing position differently from the Greek; the alignment must be checked independently.
